description: Capability for the main window (Worldloom M2.5 I3). HARDENED: no static fs:scope ships — a compromised renderer starts with access only to the app-specific dirs that fs:default grants (AppConfig/AppData/AppLocalData/AppCache/AppLog; residual broad grant, WHY: @tauri-apps/plugin-store reads/writes worldloom-settings.json in AppData and the fs plugin's own default set scopes there by design). Vault access is granted one directory at a time at runtime: (1) the folder picker auto-allows exactly the user-chosen dir via tauri-plugin-dialog, (2) boot re-open re-grants the single persisted vault dir after Rust-side sanitization (src-tauri/src/vault_scope.rs). Regression tripwires: src/app/adapters/fs-scope.test.ts and vault_scope::tests::capability_json_grants_no_blanket_fs_scope.
